claim: A thing that makes a sound when used (a flushed toilet) needs no wire: an invisible kSwitchToggle (type 20) with trigger_push and the sound in both data_1 and data_2 plays it on either change, standing in the thing.
evidence: E2M4 sprite 845: type 20, cstat 33152 (invisible), trigger_push 1, data_1 369, data_2 369, in sector 469 (the toilet's bowl)
use: Stand the toggle in the fitting; declare no channel, since it has no tx or rx.
